_readme: The Workbench's part of the Copilot Insights site's appsettings.Production.json (in the site's folder, kept by every update). dashboard\Install-CopilotInsights.ps1 -GovernanceDatabase writes ConnectionStrings:Governance and Notifications:WorkbenchBaseUrl itself; add the other sections by hand, replacing every <...> value, then recycle the app pool. Sign-in (Windows or Entra), the form keys shared by several web servers and the Insights section stay as the installer writes them: the Workbench uses the site's. No secrets here: SQL uses Windows authentication as the app pool's account.

Notifications.WorkbenchBaseUrl: https://<the site's address, with its virtual directory if any, without /workbench>

Tenant.CatalogId: <entitlement management catalog ID of the governed access packages>
